items.name: What a Torn Meniscus Actually Is
body: sits a C-shaped cushion of cartilage

items.name: Watch For These Warning Signs
body: Your knee buckling or giving way
on stairs, plus catching or clicking
happen in the US every year

items.name: Two Very Different Causes
body: In young, active people, it's usually
a forceful twist with the foot planted -
In older adults, cartilage wears down
over time with no injury at all

items.name: First, Rest and Ice the Knee
body: every 3 to 4 hours for a few days

items.name: See a Doctor If You Notice This
body: A knee stuck bent or straight
